def getname(letter):
    symbol_map = {
        ",": "coma",
        ".": "fs",
        "?": "que",
        "<": "ang1",
        ">": "ang2",
        "{": "cur1",
        "}": "cur2",
        ":": "colon",
        "/": "div",
        "-": "sub",
        "(": "par1",
        ")": "par2",
        "[": "sqr1",
        "]": "sqr2",
        "*": "star",
        "=": "equal",
        "+": "plus",
        "$": lambda: "dol" + str(random.randint(1, 2)),
        '"': "quo"
    }

    if letter.isupper():
        return "c" + letter.lower()
    elif letter in symbol_map:
        mapped = symbol_map[letter]
        return mapped() if callable(mapped) else mapped
    return letter
